scope: Benchmark theory domain: tree-level e+e- -> mu+mu- through one s-channel photon (point-like fermions, unpolarized beams, alpha = e^2/(4 pi)), differential and integrated cross sections with a SymPy derivation from Dirac matrices and a reference read from the PDG review (eqs. 51.2, 51.3). Validity: sqrt(s) well above the muon mass and well below the Z mass; no radiative corrections.
exclusions: QED radiative corrections, running of alpha, beam polarization
Any experiment, detector, data or blinding field
Claims of formal proof: the derivation is an analytic derivation checked with SymPy

capabilities.name: symbolic-derivation
capabilities.scope: SymPy derivation of the spin-averaged squared amplitude, d sigma / d Omega, d sigma / d cos theta and sigma(beta) from explicit Dirac matrices; agreement with PDG eqs. 51.2 and 51.3 (analytic derivation, not formal proof)

capabilities.name: numerical-prediction
capabilities.scope: Bin-averaged d sigma / d cos theta and integrated cross sections at a given sqrt(s) with an integration convergence study

capabilities.name: standalone-theory-path
capabilities.scope: Path C (examples/qed-benchmark): theory spec, derivation record and prediction artifacts with zero experiment resources read (recorded per run)
